title: Resolve the marker browser check root and bundler dependency before creating scratch output
outcome: The manual marker browser check uses the repository root consistently and gives a clear dependency error before creating misplaced scratch directories.
acceptance: The browser check derives or validates its repository root independently of the caller's working directory; running from ui or another directory cannot create a stray ui/.tmp tree before failure.
The esbuild dependency is explicitly supported or fails clearly before scratch output is created, and the documented root invocation still checks the actual React component in light and dark.
The unused single-value density dimension is removed or replaced with correctly resolved density coverage, with its actual scope stated.
